signalEntropy.title: Signal Entropy
signalEntropy.subtitle: Quantile-bins a numeric signal and measures how much genuine information it carries, in bits — distinct from gap detection or cross-signal correlation
signalEntropy.noSignals: No telemetry signals have been recorded for this vehicle yet.
signalEntropy.stuckHint: occupancy of the single most common bin
signalEntropy.notEnough: Not enough samples yet for a rolling entropy window on this signal.
signalEntropy.pickOne: Choose a signal above to compute its entropy.
signalEntropy.rollingHint: Entropy recomputed over a sliding window using the same global bin edges, so spikes reflect genuinely eventful stretches
signalEntropy.rollingAria: Line chart of rolling Shannon entropy in bits over time for the selected signal
signalEntropy.distributionHint: Sample counts per equal-frequency bin — a lopsided distribution here explains a low entropy score
signalEntropy.distributionAria: Bar chart of sample counts across quantile bins for the selected signal
signalEntropy.noReading: Pick a signal to see how its entropy should be read.
signalEntropy.parkedText: This signal spends almost all of its time in a single quantile bin — most samples are telling you the same thing over and over.
signalEntropy.activeText: This signal spreads its samples across multiple bins, so each new reading is genuinely informative rather than decoration on a fixed state.
signalEntropy.rangeText: {{min}} to {{max}} across {{n}} samples in the last {{h}}h window

signalTrend.title: Signal Trend
signalTrend.subtitle: Robust slope and significance for slow, monotonic drift in a numeric signal — distinct from abrupt change points, anomaly scoring, or cross-signal correlation
signalTrend.noSignals: No telemetry signals have been recorded for this vehicle yet.
signalTrend.spreadHint: robust MAD around the fitted line
signalTrend.notEnough: Not enough history yet for this signal.
signalTrend.pickOne: Choose a signal above to compute its trend.
signalTrend.chartHint: The forecast is never projected further ahead than the signal has actually been observed, and only appears when the trend is significant
signalTrend.chartAria: Composed chart of actual signal values, the fitted robust baseline, and an evidence-limited forecast band
signalTrend.noReading: Pick a signal to see how its trend should be read.
signalTrend.realText: The ordering of values is unlikely to be chance, so the fitted slope reflects a genuine slow drift rather than noise.
signalTrend.noiseText: The observed ordering does not clear the significance bar, so any apparent slope here is best treated as noise rather than a real trend.
signalTrend.limitedText: Too few samples or too short a time span to trust significance or a forecast — the slope alone is shown, withheld from projection.
signalTrend.sufficientText: The forecast band is capped at the observed time span itself, never projected further into the future than the signal has actually been watched.

signalChangePoints.title: Signal Change Points
signalChangePoints.subtitle: Robust Page-Hinkley detection of abrupt level shifts in a numeric signal — deliberately distinct from slow drift (Signal Trend) and drive-week regime clustering
signalChangePoints.noSignals: No telemetry signals have been recorded for this vehicle yet.
signalChangePoints.notEnough: Not enough history yet for this signal.
signalChangePoints.pickOne: Choose a signal above to detect its change points.
signalChangePoints.timelineHint: Raw values against each segment’s mean; dashed markers are detected change points
signalChangePoints.timelineAria: Line chart of raw signal values overlaid with segment mean levels and detected abrupt change points
signalChangePoints.noReading: Pick a signal to see how its change points should be read.
signalChangePoints.shiftedText: This signal stepped to a new stable level at least once — a different failure mode from a slow ramp, which would show no alarm here at all.
signalChangePoints.stableText: No abrupt level shift cleared the alarm threshold across the window analyzed; single-sample spikes are deliberately not enough to trigger one.
signalChangePoints.scopeText: This detector looks only at this one signal’s raw sample sequence over {{h}}h — it is not the same as the aggregate drive-week regime clustering elsewhere in the app.
